title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Exodus 2: the birth of Moses, his rescue from the river, his flight to Midian and God hearing Israel's cry.

questions.text: How long did Moses' mother hide him after he was born?
questions.explanation: When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

questions.text: What did his mother put the baby in?
questions.explanation: She took a papyrus basket, coated it with tar and pitch, put the child in it and laid it in the reeds by the river's bank.

answers.text: A wooden chest lined with wool
A clay jar sealed with wax
A papyrus basket coated with tar
A small boat made of cedar

questions.text: Who stood far off to see what would happen to the baby?
questions.explanation: His sister stood far off to see what would be done to him.

questions.text: Who found the basket among the reeds?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh's daughter came down to bathe at the river, saw the basket among the reeds and sent her servant to get it.

questions.text: Whom did Moses' sister call when she offered to find a nurse for the child?
questions.explanation: His sister offered to call a nurse from the Hebrew women, and when Pharaoh's daughter said "Go," she went and called the child's mother.

questions.text: Why did Pharaoh's daughter name the child Moses?
questions.explanation: She named him Moses and said, "Because I drew him out of the water."

answers.text: Because he cried when she opened the basket
Because she drew him out of the water
Because he was born in the river

questions.text: What did Moses do when he saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Moses looked this way and that, and when he saw no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

answers.text: He killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand
He reported the Egyptian to Pharaoh
He took the Hebrew to his own house
He ran away without doing anything

questions.text: To which land did Moses flee from Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: When Pharaoh sought to kill him, Moses fled and lived in the land of Midian, where he sat down by a well.

questions.text: Who became Moses' wife in Midian?
questions.explanation: Moses was content to dwell with the man, and he gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

questions.text: When the children of Israel cried out because of their bondage, what did God remember?
questions.explanation: God heard their groaning and remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.

answers.text: The kindness of the Hebrew midwives
His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
The promise Moses had made in Midian
